fnol_text: My name is Jordan Ferreira and I live at 592 Alder Way, Clinton, NC 28322. You can reach me on (555) 278-2711 or jordan.ferreira@example.com. A delivery driver slipped on our icy front steps on 7 January 2025 and was taken to hospital. They have said they will make a claim against us. Policy HH-2024-00031. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home. I assume this is covered under my policy?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Ferreira on (555) 278-2711 to acknowledge the claim. Jordan confirmed the loss date as 7 January 2025.
Site visit to 592 Alder Way. Neighbour Marcus Ballard was present and confirmed the timeline.
Injured party Ravi Pereira sustained whiplash and was treated at St. Brendan's Hospital. Do not admit liability; refer.
